extension.summary: One hub for everything: Umbrella, The Loop, search and debrid tools.
extension.description: Personal launcher addon. Deep-links into Umbrella and The Loop, adds one-tap search, AllDebrid/TorBox connect buttons, and CocoScrapers auto-configuration. Edit resources/menu.json to change the menus.
